title: SVJ Override File
description: A delta file applying an RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch on top of a base SVJ file (see SVJ_Spec.md §3.4).

base.description: Relative path to the base .svj.json file this override patches.

patch.description: RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch applied over the resolved base document. additionalProperties is intentionally unrestricted — the patch may touch any key in the base schema.
